# Form-email fixtures

Each file is one notification email as the inbound pipeline receives it (the
headers that matter, the text part, the HTML part) and what reading it must
produce (`expect`).

**Real emails beat these.** The ones here follow each builder's documented
format (the `note` says which) and are not captured mail. Replace them with
real notifications, with personal details changed, as they arrive — Gabe's
Wix notifications first. Never commit a real person's details.
